title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Workspaces updates for shared team work
summary: Hold: the page labels the arrival state as not stated even though Microsoft explicitly says existing notebooks automatically become workspaces without administrator action. The roadmap facts and documented controls check out, but the Graph control note should identify applyOnce and the setting property, and the action rating understates the imminent automatic change.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the tenant-level Copilot Pages and Notebooks control.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.
claims.fix: Keep the call. Append to controls[0].note and its rendered table note: 'Set mode to applyOnce; in baseline.resources use resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1, and properties.value "0" to disable or "1" to enable.' The endpoint defaults to monitorOnly; the resource and values are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.
